title: Display-Presets.9x
field.captureHint: Capture saves the windows visible on each screen. Empty creates a preset you fill in yourself.
field.renameHint: Rename “%1”. Its id stays the same, so keybindings keep working.
empty.title: No presets yet
empty.body: Arrange your windows across your screens, then press New to save that layout.
hint.keys: Enter apply · 1–9 direct · M edit · N new · X delete · Ctrl+↑↓ order
action.fileHint: Open presets.json in the text editor
action.emptyHint: Create an empty preset and fill it in the editor
editor.title: Edit preset
editor.name: Name
editor.othersHint: Tucks away windows that are not part of the preset.
editor.noApps: No apps: this screen is left alone.
editor.unsaved: Unsaved changes. Press again to discard them.
editor.keptScreens: Screens not connected, kept as they are: %1
editor.hint: ‹ › change screen · ↑ ↓ change order · ✎ details · Ctrl+S save · Esc back
app.name: Name
app.commandHint: What you would type in a terminal to start the app.
app.classHint: Used to recognise a window that is already open. Empty: guessed from the command.
layout.freeTip: Place every window exactly on the screen
layout.autoTip: Go back to Hyprland's automatic placement
tile.splitRightTip: Cut the tile in two side by side: the copy goes to the right
tile.splitDownTip: Cut the tile in two, one above the other: the copy goes below
tile.appTip: Pick another app for this tile
tile.tooMany: Too many tiles for this screen.
tile.hint: Drag a tile onto another to move it: on an edge it goes beside it; in the middle the two swap. Or click it to split it, change its app or adjust its size.
browser.title: %1: which address to open? (optional)
browser.webappTip: No address bar or tabs, like your YouTube or Discord
browser.windowTip: A browser window with its tabs
browser.webappHint: A window without address bar, recognised by its address: the preset finds it again and never opens it twice. Opened by your default browser (Helium, Chromium, Chrome, Brave…).
browser.windowHint: A normal browser window. The preset finds it by the browser, not by the address: do not put two windows of the same browser with different addresses if you need to tell them apart.
browser.blankHint: No address: a new empty window of this browser, opened on its start page. The preset reuses an open window of the browser instead of opening it twice.
browser.badUrl: That is not a valid web address, for example youtube.com
